title: Preview: the changeover
note: Mechanics preview on an invented railway, not history. The analogue of S1: twelve days across the summer timetable change of 1 May, a chain of meetings Aubrevaux – Corlaine – Quellingen – Tolvenberg whose last two windows fall after the change, holding only the winter guide; the Ardesian political police subscribed from the start; rent on 1 May and a bill at Tolvenberg on 7 May.

values.name: starting cash
values.rationale: A few days in Corvenia; marks must be drawn later.

values.name: rent
values.rationale: £8 a month from the credit, due 1 May.

values.name: bill
values.rationale: £25 domiciled at the Tolvenberg correspondent, maturing 7 May.

values.name: stage windows
values.value: Aubrevaux 27 Apr 14.00–18.00; Corlaine 29 Apr 10.00–16.00; Quellingen 2 May 10.00–18.00; Tolvenberg 4 May 12.00–20.00
values.rationale: The last two fall after the changeover, so the winter guide misleads on that corridor.
